mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers investor concerns about labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 3.5%, or the rate rise is not sustained beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in economic demand (GDPC1) and a decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable macro environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% and FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both proxies move in the predicted directions, or their combined effect is offset by external factors.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, slowing supply-side growth (INDPRO) while robust demand (GDPC1) signals overvaluation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% while GDPC1 growth > 1%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain non-negative despite the late-cycle indicators, or the regime is not confirmed by other leading indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in CPIAUCSL above 2.0% triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, compressing growth prospects and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0%, or the inflation spike is temporary.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both economic demand (GDPC1) and labor market activity (HOUST) creates a robust growth environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both increase > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both proxies move in the predicted directions, or their combined effect is offset by external factors.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in supply-side activity (INDPRO) below its 100-index baseline signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite INDPRO falling below 100, or the index decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Improving labor conditions (UNRATE < 3.5%) combined with tight monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals a post-shock recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both triggers are met, or the regime conditions are not sustained beyond the trigger period.
